Callout.Name: Cyclist Down
Callout.Message: Cyclist off a bicycle, suspected fracture.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, helmet on, bicycle in the road.

Script.Line: The door opened in front of me. I had nowhere left to go.
My wrist went under me, but the arm is the problem, not the wrist.
Nobody got the number. Do not ask me for the number.

Callout.Patient: The bike is fine. I am not sure the arm is.

Lines.Approach: He came off at the junction. Helmet is still on him and he is talking.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
